import sqlite3
import smtplib
import re
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage
DB_PATH = 'campaigns.db'

def send_campaign_test_and_log(campaign_id: int, recipient: str) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(campaign_id, int) or campaign_id <= 0:
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'invalid campaign_id'}
    if not re.match('^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$', recipient or ''):
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'invalid recipient'}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT subject, body_html FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', (campaign_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'campaign not found'}
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['Subject'] = '[TEST] ' + row[0]
    msg['From'] = 'marketing@example.com'
    msg['To'] = recipient
    msg.set_content('HTML required')
    msg.add_alternative(row[1], subtype='html')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO send_log (campaign_id, recipient, kind) VALUES (?, ?, 'test')", (campaign_id, recipient))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    # Rebuild the send-stats report after logging the test send
    subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/refresh_send_stats.py', '--campaign-id', str(campaign_id)], check=False)
    return {'ok': True}
